title: Illuminated Manuscript
description: After a Gothic book of hours: blackletter (or uncial) headings, gilded initial letters on painted grounds, titles and rubrics in red and blue, an ivy-and-bar border around each chapter opening, and an optional vellum page tint.
best_for: Prayer books, psalters, offices, the Rule, lives of saints, gift and presentation editions.

text.help: Fell is an early printed face; Garamond is smoother

tint.help: vellum-coloured pages (printed to the edge, so the file gets bleed)

pilcrows.help: red and blue paragraph marks instead of indents
